sections.text_helper: Section 56.4.16 "Timer input XOR function" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2786.
sections.section_content:
The TI1S bit in the TIMx_CR2 register, allows the input filter of channel 1 to be connected to
the output of an XOR gate, combining the two input pins tim_ti1 and tim_ti2.
The XOR output can be used with all the timer input functions such as trigger or input
capture. It is useful for measuring the interval between the edges on two input signals, as
shown in Figure713.
[Figure 713. Measuring time interval between edges on 2 signals]
